verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own AI assistant is documented as able to "check your calendar" (docs-12, docs-28), and the homepage says the AI connects to Calendar to automate workflows without leaving the inbox (docs-24). This counts as the product's own, though thin, calendar capability. Nothing documents a visible calendar view, responding to invites, or creating events from within the client. Missing for 10: in-client calendar view, invite RSVP/response handling, event creation, detailed docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
